working_memory.text: The Ottery lantern walk returns in November with lanterns made from willow and tissue paper at free workshops during half term. The procession leaves the school field at dusk, follows the river path and finishes at the harbour, where a brass band plays and hot chocolate is sold from the lifeboat station. Organisers expect about four hundred walkers and have asked drivers to avoid the harbour road for two hours. Last year's rain kept numbers low, so the date has been moved a week earlier.
